Part I · Chapter 3第一部分 · 第 3 章

Whitening and the Geometry of ICA白化与 ICA 的几何

Second-order statistics determine the mixing matrix up to a rotation. Whitening, PCA reduction, and why a rotation is exactly what higher-order statistics must find.

二阶统计量只能把混合矩阵确定到一个旋转。白化、PCA 降维，以及为什么高阶统计量要找的恰好是这个旋转。

Go to chapter text直接读正文 Glossary & symbols术语与符号 Download chapter Python下载本章 Python

First pass第一次读这一章

Whitening puts every retained direction on a comparable variance scale and removes linear correlation. Think “fix the ruler and straighten the covariance ellipse,” not “discover the hidden sources.” ICA still has to choose an orientation after that preparation.

白化把每个保留方向调到可比较的方差尺度，并去掉线性相关。可以把它理解为“统一尺子、整理协方差椭圆”，而不是“发现隐藏源”。完成这一步后，ICA 仍需选择方向。

After this pass, you should be able to:

读完这一遍，你应该能：

  • Whiten two uncorrelated coordinates with variances four and nine.
  • Explain what identity covariance guarantees, and what it does not.
  • Recognize why a zero-variance direction cannot be rescaled to variance one.
  • 能白化方差分别为四和九的两个不相关坐标。
  • 能说明单位协方差保证什么、不保证什么。
  • 能识别为什么零方差方向不能靠缩放变成单位方差。

Before you start: review matrix mixing, covariance in the independence section, and transpose notation. Standard deviation is the square root of variance.

先备知识：回看矩阵混合、独立性一节中的协方差和转置符号。标准差是方差的平方根。

Read first: centering, whitening matrices, the whitened model, then the SVD implementation. Read rank reduction before real-data work. The asymptotic lower-bound proof in finite-sample whitening can wait for the statistics chapter; keep its warning that sample whitening is not population whitening.

先读路线：中心化→白化矩阵→白化后的模型→SVD 实现。处理真实数据前读降秩。有限样本白化中的渐近下界证明可等到统计理论章，但要先记住样本白化不等于总体白化。

3.1 What the covariance can do协方差能做什么

Chapter 1第 1 章 counted parameters. For a square model with unit-variance sources, the covariance Cx=AA⊤\bC_{\bx} = \bA\bA^\topCx​=AA⊤ supplies n(n+1)/2n(n+1)/2n(n+1)/2 numbers about the n2n^2n2 entries of A\bAA, and every AQ\bA\bQAQ with Q\bQQ orthogonal has the same covariance (Section 1.4第 1.4 节). This chapter turns the count into a procedure. Whitening uses the covariance to remove everything except a rotation: after whitening, the mixing matrix is orthogonal, and ICA reduces to a search over orthogonal matrices.

Chapter 1第 1 章数过参数：对源为单位方差的方阵模型，协方差 Cx=AA⊤\bC_{\bx} = \bA\bA^\topCx​=AA⊤ 只提供关于 A\bAA 的 n2n^2n2 个元素的 n(n+1)/2n(n+1)/2n(n+1)/2 个数，而且对任意正交矩阵 Q\bQQ，AQ\bA\bQAQ 都有相同的协方差（Section 1.4第 1.4 节）。本章把这一计数变成一个具体步骤。白化利用协方差消去除旋转以外的一切：白化之后混合矩阵是正交的，ICA 归结为在正交矩阵中的搜索。

Most algorithms in this book use this reduction, from the angle search of Section 1.5第 1.5 节 to FastICA (Chapter 8第 8 章) and JADE (Chapter 9第 9 章); Comon (1994) built his ICA algorithm on it, and Hyvärinen, Karhunen and Oja (2001) give a textbook account. Figure 3.1图 3.1 shows its geometry. The reduction also has costs, which the second half of the chapter examines. When there are more sensors than sources, whitening is where the dimension is reduced and where noise enters (Section 3.6第 3.6 节). And because whitening is fixed before the rotation is estimated, its sampling error can never be corrected afterwards (Section 3.7第 3.7 节).

本书的大多数算法都采用这种约化，从Section 1.5第 1.5 节中的角度搜索，到 FastICA（Chapter 8第 8 章）和 JADE（Chapter 9第 9 章）；Comon（1994）的 ICA 算法就建立在这种约化之上，Hyvärinen、Karhunen 与 Oja（2001）的教材也有系统的介绍。Figure 3.1图 3.1 展示了它的几何含义。这种约化也有代价，本章后半部分专门讨论。当传感器多于源时，降维和噪声的引入都发生在白化这一步（Section 3.6第 3.6 节）。而且白化在估计旋转之前就已固定，它的抽样误差事后再也无法纠正（Section 3.7第 3.7 节）。

3.2 Centering and covariance中心化与协方差

Let x∈Rm\bx \in \R^mx∈Rm have finite second moments. Centering replaces x\bxx by x−E[x]\bx - \E[\bx]x−E[x]; in the model x=As\bx = \bA\bsx=As this removes the source means, which can be restored at the end as WE[x]\bW\E[\bx]WE[x] (Section 1.2第 1.2 节). From now on x\bxx has zero mean and covariance Cx=E[xx⊤]\bC_{\bx} = \E[\bx\bx^\top]Cx​=E[xx⊤]. Under the model, the source covariance Cs=E[ss⊤]\bC_{\bs} = \E[\bs\bs^\top]Cs​=E[ss⊤] is diagonal because the sources are independent, and

设 x∈Rm\bx \in \R^mx∈Rm 的二阶矩有限。中心化就是用 x−E[x]\bx - \E[\bx]x−E[x] 代替 x\bxx；在模型 x=As\bx = \bA\bsx=As 中，这一步去掉了源的均值，而源的均值可以在最后用 WE[x]\bW\E[\bx]WE[x] 恢复（Section 1.2第 1.2 节）。以下总设 x\bxx 均值为零，协方差为 Cx=E[xx⊤]\bC_{\bx} = \E[\bx\bx^\top]Cx​=E[xx⊤]。在模型之下，由于各源独立，源的协方差 Cs=E[ss⊤]\bC_{\bs} = \E[\bs\bs^\top]Cs​=E[ss⊤] 是对角的，并且

Cx=A Cs A⊤,(3.1)\bC_{\bx} = \bA\,\bC_{\bs}\,\bA^\top,\tag{3.1}Cx​=ACs​A⊤,(3.1)

which equals AA⊤\bA\bA^\topAA⊤ for unit-variance sources. The covariance is symmetric and positive semidefinite, and its rank equals that of A\bAA, which is nnn under Assumption 1.1假设 1.1. It is positive definite when m=nm = nm=n. When m>nm > nm>n it is singular in the noise-free model, and its null space is the orthogonal complement of the column space of A\bAA.

对单位方差的源，它等于 AA⊤\bA\bA^\topAA⊤。协方差是对称半正定矩阵，其秩等于 A\bAA 的秩，在Assumption 1.1假设 1.1下为 nnn。当 m=nm = nm=n 时它正定。当 m>nm > nm>n 时，在无噪声模型中它是奇异的，其零空间是 A\bAA 列空间的正交补。

From samples x(1),…,x(T)\bx(1), \dots, \bx(T)x(1),…,x(T), collected as the columns of X∈Rm×T\bX \in \R^{m \times T}X∈Rm×T, the sample mean xˉ=1T∑tx(t)\bar\bx = \frac1T\sum_t \bx(t)xˉ=T1​∑t​x(t) and the sample covariance

给定样本 x(1),…,x(T)\bx(1), \dots, \bx(T)x(1),…,x(T)，并把它们排成 X∈Rm×T\bX \in \R^{m \times T}X∈Rm×T 的各列，用样本均值 xˉ=1T∑tx(t)\bar\bx = \frac1T\sum_t \bx(t)xˉ=T1​∑t​x(t) 和样本协方差

C^x=1T∑t=1T(x(t)−xˉ)(x(t)−xˉ)⊤=1T X~X~⊤,X~=X−xˉ 1⊤,\hat\bC_{\bx} = \frac1T\sum_{t=1}^T \bigl(\bx(t) - \bar\bx\bigr)\bigl(\bx(t) - \bar\bx\bigr)^\top = \frac1T\,\tilde\bX\tilde\bX^\top, \qquad \tilde\bX = \bX - \bar\bx\,\mathbf{1}^\top,C^x​=T1​t=1∑T​(x(t)−xˉ)(x(t)−xˉ)⊤=T1​X~X~⊤,X~=X−xˉ1⊤,

replace their population counterparts. Dividing by T−1T - 1T−1 instead of TTT makes C^x\hat\bC_{\bx}C^x​ unbiased; for ICA the choice is immaterial, since it rescales all whitened outputs by the same constant. When fourth moments are finite, each entry of C^x\hat\bC_{\bx}C^x​ has a standard error of order T−1/2T^{-1/2}T−1/2, a fact that returns in Section 3.7第 3.7 节. Because the centered samples sum to zero, C^x\hat\bC_{\bx}C^x​ has rank at most T−1T - 1T−1, so it is singular whenever m≥Tm \ge Tm≥T, and a reduction of dimension is then unavoidable. This is the situation in temporal ICA of fMRI, where the voxels play the role of sensors (Section 14.3第 14.3 节).

来代替相应的总体量。分母用 T−1T - 1T−1 代替 TTT 可使 C^x\hat\bC_{\bx}C^x​ 无偏；对 ICA 而言这无关紧要，因为它只是把所有白化后的输出乘上同一个常数。当四阶矩有限时，C^x\hat\bC_{\bx}C^x​ 每个元素的标准误都是 T−1/2T^{-1/2}T−1/2 量级，这一点在Section 3.7第 3.7 节中还会用到。由于中心化后的样本之和为零，C^x\hat\bC_{\bx}C^x​ 的秩至多为 T−1T - 1T−1，所以当 m≥Tm \ge Tm≥T 时它必然奇异，此时降维不可避免。fMRI 的时间 ICA 就属于这种情形，在那里体素扮演传感器的角色（Section 14.3第 14.3 节）。

Numerically, the eigenvectors and eigenvalues of C^x\hat\bC_{\bx}C^x​ are best obtained from the singular value decomposition X~=EΓF⊤\tilde\bX = \mathbf{E}\boldsymbol{\Gamma}\bF^\topX~=EΓF⊤: the eigenvectors are the columns of E\mathbf{E}E and the eigenvalues are γi2/T\gamma_i^2/Tγi2​/T. This avoids forming X~X~⊤\tilde\bX\tilde\bX^\topX~X~⊤, which squares the condition number (Golub & Van Loan, 2013).

在数值计算上，C^x\hat\bC_{\bx}C^x​ 的特征向量与特征值最好通过奇异值分解 X~=EΓF⊤\tilde\bX = \mathbf{E}\boldsymbol{\Gamma}\bF^\topX~=EΓF⊤ 求得：特征向量是 E\mathbf{E}E 的各列，特征值为 γi2/T\gamma_i^2/Tγi2​/T。这样可以避免显式构造 X~X~⊤\tilde\bX\tilde\bX^\topX~X~⊤，后者会把条件数平方（Golub & Van Loan, 2013）。

3.3 Whitening matrices白化矩阵

A random vector is white if its components are uncorrelated and have unit variance. Whitening transforms the data linearly so that they become white.

若一个随机向量的各分量互不相关且方差为一，则称它是白的。白化就是对数据作线性变换，使之变白。

Micro example: divide by standard deviation, not variance微型手算：除以标准差，而不是方差

Assume x1,x2x_1,x_2x1​,x2​ have mean zero, variances 4,94,94,9, and covariance zero. Thus Cx=diag⁡(4,9)\bC_{\bx}=\diag(4,9)Cx​=diag(4,9).

设 x1,x2x_1,x_2x1​,x2​ 均值为零、方差为 4,94,94,9，协方差为零，因此 Cx=diag⁡(4,9)\bC_{\bx}=\diag(4,9)Cx​=diag(4,9)。

  1. The standard deviations are 222 and 333. Set z1=x1/2z_1=x_1/2z1​=x1​/2 and z2=x2/3z_2=x_2/3z2​=x2​/3.
  2. Variances scale by the square of the multiplier: Var⁡(z1)=4/22=1\Var(z_1)=4/2^2=1Var(z1​)=4/22=1 and Var⁡(z2)=9/32=1\Var(z_2)=9/3^2=1Var(z2​)=9/32=1. Their covariance remains zero.
  3. So V=diag⁡(1/2,1/3)\bV=\diag(1/2,1/3)V=diag(1/2,1/3) gives VCxV⊤=I\bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top=\bIVCx​V⊤=I. One observation (2,6)(2,6)(2,6) becomes (1,2)(1,2)(1,2).
  1. 标准差是 222 和 333。令 z1=x1/2z_1=x_1/2z1​=x1​/2、z2=x2/3z_2=x_2/3z2​=x2​/3。
  2. 方差按乘数的平方缩放：Var⁡(z1)=4/22=1\Var(z_1)=4/2^2=1Var(z1​)=4/22=1、Var⁡(z2)=9/32=1\Var(z_2)=9/3^2=1Var(z2​)=9/32=1，二者的协方差仍为零。
  3. 所以 V=diag⁡(1/2,1/3)\bV=\diag(1/2,1/3)V=diag(1/2,1/3) 满足 VCxV⊤=I\bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top=\bIVCx​V⊤=I。一个观测 (2,6)(2,6)(2,6) 被变为 (1,2)(1,2)(1,2)。

This proves whiteness for the specified covariance. It does not prove independence, and it does not require each observation to have length one. Variance describes a distribution across observations, not the size of one vector.

这证明了对给定协方差的白化，却没有证明独立，也不要求每个观测的长度为一。方差描述许多观测构成的分布，不是单个向量的大小。

Quick check 1. If the covariance is diag⁡(4,0)\diag(4,0)diag(4,0), can a two-dimensional linear transform make it I2\bI_2I2​?

自测 1。若协方差是 diag⁡(4,0)\diag(4,0)diag(4,0)，能否用二维线性变换把它变成 I2\bI_2I2​？

Check the answer查看答案

No. Its rank is one and a linear transform cannot increase that rank. Retain the varying coordinate and whiten it by dividing by two; the constant coordinate contains no second direction to recover.

不能。它的秩为一，线性变换不能增加这个秩。可保留有变化的坐标并除以二来白化；常数坐标并不包含可恢复的第二个方向。

Quick check 2. If z\bzz is white and Q\bQQ is orthogonal, is Qz\bQ\bzQz also white?

自测 2。若 z\bzz 是白的、Q\bQQ 正交，Qz\bQ\bzQz 也一定白吗？

Check the answer查看答案

Yes: its covariance is QIQ⊤=I\bQ\bI\bQ^\top=\bIQIQ⊤=I. This is precisely why whitening leaves an orientation undecided; it does not show the rotated coordinates are independent.

是。它的协方差是 QIQ⊤=I\bQ\bI\bQ^\top=\bIQIQ⊤=I。这恰好解释了为什么白化还留有未决定的方向，却不能说明旋转后的坐标独立。

Definition 3.1 (whitening)定义 3.1（白化）

Let x∈Rm\bx \in \R^mx∈Rm have zero mean and covariance Cx\bC_{\bx}Cx​. A matrix V∈Rk×m\bV \in \R^{k \times m}V∈Rk×m is a whitening matrix for x\bxx if z=Vx\bz = \bV\bxz=Vx satisfies E[zz⊤]=VCxV⊤=Ik\E[\bz\bz^\top] = \bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top = \bI_kE[zz⊤]=VCx​V⊤=Ik​. The vector z\bzz is then called white, or sphered.

设 x∈Rm\bx \in \R^mx∈Rm 均值为零，协方差为 Cx\bC_{\bx}Cx​。若 z=Vx\bz = \bV\bxz=Vx 满足 E[zz⊤]=VCxV⊤=Ik\E[\bz\bz^\top] = \bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top = \bI_kE[zz⊤]=VCx​V⊤=Ik​，则称矩阵 V∈Rk×m\bV \in \R^{k \times m}V∈Rk×m 为 x\bxx 的白化矩阵，称 z\bzz 是白的，或球化的。

Since rank⁡(VCxV⊤)≤rank⁡Cx\rank(\bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top) \le \rank\bC_{\bx}rank(VCx​V⊤)≤rankCx​, necessarily k≤rank⁡Cxk \le \rank\bC_{\bx}k≤rankCx​. In the noise-free model rank⁡Cx=n\rank\bC_{\bx} = nrankCx​=n, and whitening to k=nk = nk=n components loses no information, because x\bxx lies almost surely in the nnn-dimensional column space of Cx\bC_{\bx}Cx​. Write the eigendecomposition of the covariance as Cx=EΛE⊤\bC_{\bx} = \mathbf{E}\bLambda\mathbf{E}^\topCx​=EΛE⊤, with E\mathbf{E}E orthogonal and Λ=diag⁡(λ1,…,λm)\bLambda = \diag(\lambda_1, \dots, \lambda_m)Λ=diag(λ1​,…,λm​), λ1≥⋯≥λm≥0\lambda_1 \ge \dots \ge \lambda_m \ge 0λ1​≥⋯≥λm​≥0 (Section A.3第 A.3 节). Suppose first that m=nm = nm=n, so that all eigenvalues are positive. Three whitening matrices are in common use:

由于 rank⁡(VCxV⊤)≤rank⁡Cx\rank(\bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top) \le \rank\bC_{\bx}rank(VCx​V⊤)≤rankCx​，必有 k≤rank⁡Cxk \le \rank\bC_{\bx}k≤rankCx​。在无噪声模型中 rank⁡Cx=n\rank\bC_{\bx} = nrankCx​=n，而白化到 k=nk = nk=n 个分量不会丢失任何信息，因为 x\bxx 几乎必然落在 Cx\bC_{\bx}Cx​ 的 nnn 维列空间里。把协方差的特征分解写成 Cx=EΛE⊤\bC_{\bx} = \mathbf{E}\bLambda\mathbf{E}^\topCx​=EΛE⊤，其中 E\mathbf{E}E 正交，Λ=diag⁡(λ1,…,λm)\bLambda = \diag(\lambda_1, \dots, \lambda_m)Λ=diag(λ1​,…,λm​)，λ1≥⋯≥λm≥0\lambda_1 \ge \dots \ge \lambda_m \ge 0λ1​≥⋯≥λm​≥0（Section A.3第 A.3 节）。先设 m=nm = nm=n，于是所有特征值都为正。常用的白化矩阵有三种：

Decode the product from right to left. E⊤\mathbf{E}^\topE⊤ expresses each observation along the covariance eigenvectors. Each λi\lambda_iλi​ is the variance on one such axis; λi−1/2\lambda_i^{-1/2}λi−1/2​ means divide by its standard deviation. Thus PCA whitening first changes coordinates and then rescales them. A zero eigenvalue blocks the second step and signals the need to restrict the subspace.

从右向左拆开这个乘积。E⊤\mathbf{E}^\topE⊤ 把每个观测改写到协方差特征向量的坐标系中。λi\lambda_iλi​ 是该轴上的方差，λi−1/2\lambda_i^{-1/2}λi−1/2​ 表示除以它的标准差。因此 PCA 白化是先换坐标、再缩放；特征值为零时不能进行第二步，需要先限制到有变化的子空间。

  • PCA whitening, V=Λ−1/2E⊤\bV = \bLambda^{-1/2}\mathbf{E}^\topV=Λ−1/2E⊤. The data are projected onto the principal axes, and each principal component is divided by its standard deviation.
  • Symmetric (ZCA) whitening, V=Cx−1/2=EΛ−1/2E⊤\bV = \bC_{\bx}^{-1/2} = \mathbf{E}\bLambda^{-1/2}\mathbf{E}^\topV=Cx−1/2​=EΛ−1/2E⊤: PCA whitening followed by the rotation E\mathbf{E}E back to the original axes. Bell and Sejnowski (1997) named it ZCA, for zero-phase component analysis. Among all whitening matrices it changes the data least, in the sense that it minimizes E∥Vx−x∥2\E\|\bV\bx - \bx\|^2E∥Vx−x∥2 (Exercise 3.3习题 3.3; Kessy, Lewin and Strimmer (2018) discuss this and other optimality properties).
  • Cholesky whitening, V=L−1\bV = \mathbf{L}^{-1}V=L−1, where Cx=LL⊤\bC_{\bx} = \mathbf{L}\mathbf{L}^\topCx​=LL⊤ with L\mathbf{L}L lower triangular with a positive diagonal. Since L−1\mathbf{L}^{-1}L−1 is also lower triangular, z1z_1z1​ depends only on x1x_1x1​, z2z_2z2​ on x1x_1x1​ and x2x_2x2​, and so on: Cholesky whitening is the Gram–Schmidt orthonormalization of x1,…,xmx_1, \dots, x_mx1​,…,xm​ in the inner product E[uv]\E[uv]E[uv] (Exercise 3.1习题 3.1).
  • PCA 白化，V=Λ−1/2E⊤\bV = \bLambda^{-1/2}\mathbf{E}^\topV=Λ−1/2E⊤。先把数据投影到主轴上，再把每个主成分除以它的标准差。
  • 对称（ZCA）白化，V=Cx−1/2=EΛ−1/2E⊤\bV = \bC_{\bx}^{-1/2} = \mathbf{E}\bLambda^{-1/2}\mathbf{E}^\topV=Cx−1/2​=EΛ−1/2E⊤：先做 PCA 白化，再用旋转 E\mathbf{E}E 转回原来的坐标轴。Bell 与 Sejnowski（1997）称之为 ZCA，即零相位成分分析（zero-phase component analysis）。在所有白化矩阵中，它对数据的改变最小，即它使 E∥Vx−x∥2\E\|\bV\bx - \bx\|^2E∥Vx−x∥2 最小（Exercise 3.3习题 3.3；Kessy、Lewin 与 Strimmer（2018）讨论了这一性质及其他最优性）。
  • Cholesky 白化，V=L−1\bV = \mathbf{L}^{-1}V=L−1，其中 Cx=LL⊤\bC_{\bx} = \mathbf{L}\mathbf{L}^\topCx​=LL⊤，L\mathbf{L}L 是对角元为正的下三角矩阵。由于 L−1\mathbf{L}^{-1}L−1 也是下三角的，z1z_1z1​ 只依赖于 x1x_1x1​，z2z_2z2​ 只依赖于 x1x_1x1​ 与 x2x_2x2​，依此类推：Cholesky 白化就是在内积 E[uv]\E[uv]E[uv] 下对 x1,…,xmx_1, \dots, x_mx1​,…,xm​ 作 Gram–Schmidt 标准正交化（Exercise 3.1习题 3.1）。

Each of them satisfies VCxV⊤=I\bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top = \bIVCx​V⊤=I; for PCA whitening, for instance, Λ−1/2E⊤(EΛE⊤)EΛ−1/2=I\bLambda^{-1/2}\mathbf{E}^\top(\mathbf{E}\bLambda\mathbf{E}^\top)\mathbf{E}\bLambda^{-1/2} = \bIΛ−1/2E⊤(EΛE⊤)EΛ−1/2=I. They are far from the only ones, but the set of all whitening matrices has a simple structure.

它们都满足 VCxV⊤=I\bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top = \bIVCx​V⊤=I；以 PCA 白化为例，Λ−1/2E⊤(EΛE⊤)EΛ−1/2=I\bLambda^{-1/2}\mathbf{E}^\top(\mathbf{E}\bLambda\mathbf{E}^\top)\mathbf{E}\bLambda^{-1/2} = \bIΛ−1/2E⊤(EΛE⊤)EΛ−1/2=I。白化矩阵远不止这三种，但所有白化矩阵构成的集合有简单的结构。

Let Cx\bC_{\bx}Cx​ be positive definite and let V1∈Rm×m\bV_1 \in \R^{m \times m}V1​∈Rm×m be a whitening matrix. (QV1)Cx(QV1)⊤=QQ⊤=I(\bQ\bV_1)\bC_{\bx}(\bQ\bV_1)^\top = \bQ\bQ^\top = \bI(QV1​)Cx​(QV1​)⊤=QQ⊤=I，所以每个 QV1\bQ\bV_1QV1​ 都是白化矩阵。反之，由 V1CxV1⊤=I\bV_1\bC_{\bx}\bV_1^\top = \bIV1​Cx​V1⊤​=I 可知方阵 V1\bV_1V1​ 可逆，且 Cx=V1−1V1−⊤\bC_{\bx} = \bV_1^{-1}\bV_1^{-\top}Cx​=V1−1​V1−⊤​。若 V2\bV_2V2​ 也是白化矩阵，则 Q=V2V1−1\bQ = \bV_2\bV_1^{-1}Q=V2​V1−1​ 满足 QQ⊤=V2V1−1V1−⊤V2⊤=V2CxV2⊤=I\bQ\bQ^\top = \bV_2\bV_1^{-1}\bV_1^{-\top}\bV_2^\top = \bV_2\bC_{\bx}\bV_2^\top = \bIQQ⊤=V2​V1−1​V1−⊤​V2⊤​=V2​Cx​V2⊤​=I。

Let x=As\bx = \bA\bsx=As with A∈Rm×n\bA \in \R^{m \times n}A∈Rm×n of full column rank and E[ss⊤]=I\E[\bs\bs^\top] = \bIE[ss⊤]=I, and let V∈Rn×m\bV \in \R^{n \times m}V∈Rn×m be a whitening matrix for x\bxx. Then A~=VA\tilde\bA = \bV\bAA~=VA is orthogonal. If instead E[ss⊤]=D2\E[\bs\bs^\top] = \bD^2E[ss⊤]=D2 with D\bDD diagonal and positive, then A~D\tilde\bA\bDA~D is orthogonal.

设 x=As\bx = \bA\bsx=As，A∈Rm×n\bA \in \R^{m \times n}A∈Rm×n 列满秩，E[ss⊤]=I\E[\bs\bs^\top] = \bIE[ss⊤]=I，并设 V∈Rn×m\bV \in \R^{n \times m}V∈Rn×m 是 x\bxx 的白化矩阵。则 A~=VA\tilde\bA = \bV\bAA~=VA 是正交矩阵。若改设 E[ss⊤]=D2\E[\bs\bs^\top] = \bD^2E[ss⊤]=D2，其中 D\bDD 是对角元为正的对角矩阵，则 A~D\tilde\bA\bDA~D 是正交矩阵。

Proof.证明

I=E[zz⊤]=VA E[ss⊤] A⊤V⊤=A~A~⊤\bI = \E[\bz\bz^\top] = \bV\bA\,\E[\bs\bs^\top]\,\bA^\top\bV^\top = \tilde\bA\tilde\bA^\topI=E[zz⊤]=VAE[ss⊤]A⊤V⊤=A~A~⊤, and a square matrix with A~A~⊤=I\tilde\bA\tilde\bA^\top = \bIA~A~⊤=I is orthogonal. With E[ss⊤]=D2\E[\bs\bs^\top] = \bD^2E[ss⊤]=D2, the same computation gives (A~D)(A~D)⊤=I(\tilde\bA\bD)(\tilde\bA\bD)^\top = \bI(A~D)(A~D)⊤=I.

I=E[zz⊤]=VA E[ss⊤] A⊤V⊤=A~A~⊤\bI = \E[\bz\bz^\top] = \bV\bA\,\E[\bs\bs^\top]\,\bA^\top\bV^\top = \tilde\bA\tilde\bA^\topI=E[zz⊤]=VAE[ss⊤]A⊤V⊤=A~A~⊤，而满足 A~A~⊤=I\tilde\bA\tilde\bA^\top = \bIA~A~⊤=I 的方阵是正交矩阵。若 E[ss⊤]=D2\E[\bs\bs^\top] = \bD^2E[ss⊤]=D2，同样的计算给出 (A~D)(A~D)⊤=I(\tilde\bA\bD)(\tilde\bA\bD)^\top = \bI(A~D)(A~D)⊤=I。

Three consequences follow. First, all white versions of the data differ by rotations, also when m>nm > nm>n: if V1\bV_1V1​ and V2\bV_2V2​ both whiten, then zk=A~ks\bz_k = \tilde\bA_k\bszk​=A~k​s with A~k\tilde\bA_kA~k​ orthogonal, so z2=A~2A~1⊤z1\bz_2 = \tilde\bA_2\tilde\bA_1^\top\bz_1z2​=A~2​A~1⊤​z1​. Second, ICA on whitened data is a search over orthogonal matrices. An orthogonal unmixing matrix U\bUU for z\bzz yields the global matrix P=UA~\bP = \bU\tilde\bAP=UA~, which is again orthogonal; an orthogonal matrix of the form ΠD\bPi\bDΠD must have D=diag⁡(±1)\bD = \diag(\pm 1)D=diag(±1) (Section A.2第 A.2 节), so the separating orthogonal matrices are exactly U=ΠDA~⊤\bU = \bPi\bD\tilde\bA^\topU=ΠDA~⊤ with ΠD\bPi\bDΠD a signed permutation. (As elsewhere in the book, we loosely call such matrices rotations; strictly, those with determinant −1-1−1 also contain a reflection.) Whitening has fixed the scale of every output, E[yi2]=1\E[y_i^2] = 1E[yi2​]=1, and only signs and order remain free. Third, the unmixing matrix for x\bxx factors as

由此得到三个推论。第一，即使 m>nm > nm>n，数据的所有白化版本之间也只差旋转：若 V1\bV_1V1​ 与 V2\bV_2V2​ 都是白化矩阵，则 zk=A~ks\bz_k = \tilde\bA_k\bszk​=A~k​s，A~k\tilde\bA_kA~k​ 正交，所以 z2=A~2A~1⊤z1\bz_2 = \tilde\bA_2\tilde\bA_1^\top\bz_1z2​=A~2​A~1⊤​z1​。第二，对白化后的数据做 ICA，就是在正交矩阵中搜索。z\bzz 的正交解混矩阵 U\bUU 给出的全局矩阵 P=UA~\bP = \bU\tilde\bAP=UA~ 仍是正交的；而形如 ΠD\bPi\bDΠD 的正交矩阵必有 D=diag⁡(±1)\bD = \diag(\pm 1)D=diag(±1)（Section A.2第 A.2 节），所以能实现分离的正交矩阵恰好是 U=ΠDA~⊤\bU = \bPi\bD\tilde\bA^\topU=ΠDA~⊤，其中 ΠD\bPi\bDΠD 是带符号的置换矩阵。（与全书其他地方一样，我们笼统地把这些矩阵称为旋转；严格说来，行列式为 −1-1−1 的那些还包含一次反射。）白化已经固定了每个输出的尺度 E[yi2]=1\E[y_i^2] = 1E[yi2​]=1，只剩符号与顺序未定。第三，x\bxx 的解混矩阵可以分解为

W=UV,U∈O(n),(3.3)\bW = \bU\bV, \qquad \bU \in O(n),\tag{3.3}W=UV,U∈O(n),(3.3)

where O(n)O(n)O(n) is the group of n×nn \times nn×n orthogonal matrices. For m=nm = nm=n, the parameter count of Section 1.4第 1.4 节 is now explicit: the n2n^2n2 entries of W\bWW split into the n(n+1)/2n(n+1)/2n(n+1)/2 numbers fixed by the covariance through V\bVV and the n(n−1)/2n(n-1)/2n(n−1)/2 parameters of U\bUU, the dimension of O(n)O(n)O(n) (Section A.2第 A.2 节). That is one angle for n=2n = 2n=2, three for n=3n = 3n=3, and 45 for n=10n = 10n=10, against 100 entries of W\bWW. Second-order statistics thus do more than half of the work. What remains is a rotation, and estimating it is the task of the higher-order methods of Parts II and III.

其中 O(n)O(n)O(n) 是 n×nn \times nn×n 正交矩阵构成的群。对 m=nm = nm=n，Section 1.4第 1.4 节中的参数计数现在一目了然：W\bWW 的 n2n^2n2 个元素分成两部分，一部分是协方差通过 V\bVV 确定的 n(n+1)/2n(n+1)/2n(n+1)/2 个数，另一部分是 U\bUU 的 n(n−1)/2n(n-1)/2n(n−1)/2 个参数，即 O(n)O(n)O(n) 的维数（Section A.2第 A.2 节）。n=2n = 2n=2 时只剩一个角度，n=3n = 3n=3 时剩三个，n=10n = 10n=10 时剩 45 个，而 W\bWW 有 100 个元素。可见二阶统计量完成了一多半的工作。剩下的是一个旋转，估计它是第二、三部分中高阶方法的任务。

Different whitening matrices give different, but rotation-equivalent, whitened mixing matrices. ZCA whitening gives a particularly natural one: for unit-variance sources and m=nm = nm=n, A~=Cx−1/2A=(AA⊤)−1/2A\tilde\bA = \bC_{\bx}^{-1/2}\bA = (\bA\bA^\top)^{-1/2}\bAA~=Cx−1/2​A=(AA⊤)−1/2A is the orthogonal factor of the polar decomposition of A\bAA, which is the orthogonal matrix closest to A\bAA (Proposition A.4命题 A.4). When the mixing is mild, with A\bAA close to the identity, ZCA-whitened data are therefore already nearly separated. For the A\bAA used in Figure 3.1图 3.1, this A~\tilde\bAA~ is a rotation by about 6°, visible in panel (c).

不同的白化矩阵给出不同的、但彼此只差旋转的白化混合矩阵。ZCA 白化给出的那一个尤其自然：对单位方差的源且 m=nm = nm=n，A~=Cx−1/2A=(AA⊤)−1/2A\tilde\bA = \bC_{\bx}^{-1/2}\bA = (\bA\bA^\top)^{-1/2}\bAA~=Cx−1/2​A=(AA⊤)−1/2A 正是 A\bAA 的极分解中的正交因子，也就是离 A\bAA 最近的正交矩阵（Proposition A.4命题 A.4）。因此当混合较弱、A\bAA 接近单位阵时，ZCA 白化后的数据已经接近分离。对Figure 3.1图 3.1所用的 A\bAA，这个 A~\tilde\bAA~ 是约 6° 的旋转，在（c）中可以看到。

Methods that estimate W\bWW directly among all invertible matrices, such as maximum likelihood with the natural gradient (Chapter 7第 7 章), do not need this reduction, although they are often run on whitened data. What the orthogonality constraint costs is examined in Section 3.7第 3.7 节.

直接在全体可逆矩阵中估计 W\bWW 的方法，例如用自然梯度求最大似然（Chapter 7第 7 章），并不需要这种约化，尽管实践中也常在白化后的数据上运行。正交约束的代价将在Section 3.7第 3.7 节中讨论。

3.5 Why second-order statistics cannot do more为什么二阶统计量做不到更多

After whitening, the covariance is used up. For every orthogonal U\bUU, the output y=Uz\by = \bU\bzy=Uz is again white, E[yy⊤]=UU⊤=I\E[\by\by^\top] = \bU\bU^\top = \bIE[yy⊤]=UU⊤=I, so no criterion that depends on the data only through their covariance can prefer one rotation to another. To find U\bUU, ICA must use statistics of order higher than two or, if the sources are time series, their temporal structure.

白化之后，协方差已经用尽。对任意正交矩阵 U\bUU，输出 y=Uz\by = \bU\bzy=Uz 仍然是白的，E[yy⊤]=UU⊤=I\E[\by\by^\top] = \bU\bU^\top = \bIE[yy⊤]=UU⊤=I；因此，任何只通过协方差依赖于数据的准则，都无法在不同旋转之间作出取舍。要找到 U\bUU，ICA 必须利用二阶以上的统计量；若源是时间序列，也可以利用它们的时间结构。

For Gaussian sources nothing else is available. If s∼N(0,I)\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)s∼N(0,I), then z=A~s∼N(0,I)\bz = \tilde\bA\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)z=A~s∼N(0,I) and y=Uz∼N(0,I)\by = \bU\bz \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)y=Uz∼N(0,I) for every orthogonal U\bUU (Exercise 1.3习题 1.3). The distribution of the outputs does not depend on U\bUU at all, so every rotation is an equally good answer, and higher-order statistics cannot help, since all cumulants of order three and higher vanish (Proposition 2.8命题 2.8).

对高斯源，除协方差之外别无可用的信息。若 s∼N(0,I)\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)s∼N(0,I)，则 z=A~s∼N(0,I)\bz = \tilde\bA\bs \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)z=A~s∼N(0,I)，并且对任意正交矩阵 U\bUU 都有 y=Uz∼N(0,I)\by = \bU\bz \sim \Ncal(\bzero, \bI)y=Uz∼N(0,I)（Exercise 1.3习题 1.3）。输出的分布与 U\bUU 完全无关，每个旋转都是同样好的答案；高阶统计量也帮不上忙，因为三阶及以上的累积量全为零（Proposition 2.8命题 2.8）。

For non-Gaussian sources the higher-order cumulants are not rotation invariant. By (2.3) applied to z=A~s\bz = \tilde\bA\bsz=A~s, the kurtosis of the projection onto a unit vector w\bww is

对非高斯源，高阶累积量在旋转下不再不变。把 (2.3) 用于 z=A~s\bz = \tilde\bA\bsz=A~s，可得 z\bzz 在单位向量 w\bww 上投影的峭度：

kurt⁡(w⊤z)=∑p=1nκp (w⊤a~p)4,\kurt(\bw^\top\bz) = \sum_{p=1}^n \kappa_p\,(\bw^\top\tilde\ba_p)^4,kurt(w⊤z)=p=1∑n​κp​(w⊤a~p​)4,

where a~p\tilde\ba_pa~p​ is the ppp-th column of A~\tilde\bAA~. If some κp≠0\kappa_p \ne 0κp​=0, this function is not constant on the unit sphere: with q=A~⊤w\bq = \tilde\bA^\top\bwq=A~⊤w and ep\be_pep​ the ppp-th coordinate vector, its values at q=ep\bq = \be_pq=ep​ and at q=(ep+er)/2\bq = (\be_p + \be_r)/\sqrt2q=(ep​+er​)/2​ are κp\kappa_pκp​ and (κp+κr)/4(\kappa_p + \kappa_r)/4(κp​+κr​)/4, and these can all be equal only if every κp\kappa_pκp​ is zero. Fourth-order statistics therefore distinguish directions, and Chapter 5第 5 章 proves that the local maxima of ∣kurt⁡(w⊤z)∣|\kurt(\bw^\top\bz)|∣kurt(w⊤z)∣ are exactly the directions ±a~p\pm\tilde\ba_p±a~p​ of the sources with nonzero kurtosis (Theorem 5.3定理 5.3).

其中 a~p\tilde\ba_pa~p​ 是 A~\tilde\bAA~ 的第 ppp 列。只要某个 κp≠0\kappa_p \ne 0κp​=0，这个函数在单位球面上就不是常数：记 q=A~⊤w\bq = \tilde\bA^\top\bwq=A~⊤w，ep\be_pep​ 为第 ppp 个坐标向量，它在 q=ep\bq = \be_pq=ep​ 与 q=(ep+er)/2\bq = (\be_p + \be_r)/\sqrt2q=(ep​+er​)/2​ 处的值分别为 κp\kappa_pκp​ 与 (κp+κr)/4(\kappa_p + \kappa_r)/4(κp​+κr​)/4，而这些值全部相等的唯一可能是所有 κp\kappa_pκp​ 都为零。所以四阶统计量能够区分方向；Chapter 5第 5 章将证明，∣kurt⁡(w⊤z)∣|\kurt(\bw^\top\bz)|∣kurt(w⊤z)∣ 的局部极大点恰好是峭度非零的那些源的方向 ±a~p\pm\tilde\ba_p±a~p​（Theorem 5.3定理 5.3）。

Between the two extremes, Chapter 4第 4 章 shows that a single Gaussian source does no harm, whereas with k≥2k \ge 2k≥2 Gaussian sources any rotation within the subspace they span leaves the distribution of z\bzz unchanged, so only that subspace can be identified (Section 4.4第 4.4 节). The special role of the Gaussian is no accident: if a random vector with n≥2n \ge 2n≥2 independent components has a distribution that is invariant under all rotations, its components are Gaussian with a common variance (Exercise 3.5习题 3.5).

介于两种极端之间的情形，Chapter 4第 4 章证明：单个高斯源无碍大局；而当有 k≥2k \ge 2k≥2 个高斯源时，在它们张成的子空间内作任意旋转都不改变 z\bzz 的分布，所以只能辨识出这个子空间（Section 4.4第 4.4 节）。高斯分布的这种特殊地位并非偶然：若一个具有 n≥2n \ge 2n≥2 个独立分量的随机向量，其分布在一切旋转下不变，则它的各分量都是方差相同的高斯变量（Exercise 3.5习题 3.5）。

Second-order statistics can do more when the samples are not i.i.d. If the sources are zero-mean stationary time series with cross-covariances zero at every lag (as holds for independent source processes), the lagged covariances of the whitened data are

当样本不再独立同分布时，二阶统计量可以做得更多。若各源是零均值平稳时间序列，且不同源在每个时滞上的互协方差都为零（相互独立的源过程满足此条件），则白化数据的时滞协方差为

Cz(τ)=E[z(t) z(t−τ)⊤]=A~ diag⁡(ρ1(τ),…,ρn(τ)) A~⊤,\bC_{\bz}(\tau) = \E\bigl[\bz(t)\,\bz(t - \tau)^\top\bigr] = \tilde\bA\,\diag\bigl(\rho_1(\tau), \dots, \rho_n(\tau)\bigr)\,\tilde\bA^\top,Cz​(τ)=E[z(t)z(t−τ)⊤]=A~diag(ρ1​(τ),…,ρn​(τ))A~⊤,

where ρi(τ)=E[si(t) si(t−τ)]\rho_i(\tau) = \E[s_i(t)\,s_i(t - \tau)]ρi​(τ)=E[si​(t)si​(t−τ)] is the autocorrelation of source iii. These matrices are not invariant under rotation. They determine A~\tilde\bAA~ up to a signed permutation as soon as, for every pair of sources, the two autocorrelation functions differ at some lag, even if all sources are Gaussian; this is the basis of AMUSE and SOBI (Chapter 9第 9 章, Theorem 9.6定理 9.6). Under the i.i.d. model of Assumption 1.1假设 1.1, however, the covariance is all that second-order statistics provide.

其中 ρi(τ)=E[si(t) si(t−τ)]\rho_i(\tau) = \E[s_i(t)\,s_i(t - \tau)]ρi​(τ)=E[si​(t)si​(t−τ)] 是源 iii 的自相关函数。这些矩阵在旋转下不是不变的。只要对每一对源，它们的自相关函数在某个时滞处不同，这些矩阵就能在带符号置换的意义下确定 A~\tilde\bAA~，即使所有源都是高斯的也是如此；这正是 AMUSE 与 SOBI 的基础（Chapter 9第 9 章，Theorem 9.6定理 9.6）。但在Assumption 1.1假设 1.1的独立同分布模型下，二阶统计量所能提供的只有协方差。

3.6 PCA dimension reductionPCA 降维

When there are more sensors than sources, m>nm > nm>n, whitening also reduces the dimension. In the noise-free model, Cx=AA⊤\bC_{\bx} = \bA\bA^\topCx​=AA⊤ has rank nnn, and its column space, the signal subspace, is the column space of A\bAA. Let λ1≥⋯≥λn>0\lambda_1 \ge \dots \ge \lambda_n > 0λ1​≥⋯≥λn​>0 be its nonzero eigenvalues, En∈Rm×n\mathbf{E}_n \in \R^{m \times n}En​∈Rm×n the corresponding orthonormal eigenvectors and Λn=diag⁡(λ1,…,λn)\bLambda_n = \diag(\lambda_1, \dots, \lambda_n)Λn​=diag(λ1​,…,λn​), so that Cx=EnΛnEn⊤\bC_{\bx} = \mathbf{E}_n\bLambda_n\mathbf{E}_n^\topCx​=En​Λn​En⊤​. 当传感器多于源（m>nm > nm>n）时，白化同时完成降维。在无噪声模型中，Cx=AA⊤\bC_{\bx} = \bA\bA^\topCx​=AA⊤ 的秩为 nnn，它的列空间即信号子空间，就是 A\bAA 的列空间。设 λ1≥⋯≥λn>0\lambda_1 \ge \dots \ge \lambda_n > 0λ1​≥⋯≥λn​>0 是它的非零特征值，En∈Rm×n\mathbf{E}_n \in \R^{m \times n}En​∈Rm×n 是相应的标准正交特征向量，Λn=diag⁡(λ1,…,λn)\bLambda_n = \diag(\lambda_1, \dots, \lambda_n)Λn​=diag(λ1​,…,λn​)，于是 Cx=EnΛnEn⊤\bC_{\bx} = \mathbf{E}_n\bLambda_n\mathbf{E}_n^\topCx​=En​Λn​En⊤​。则 V=Λn−1/2En⊤∈Rn×m\bV = \bLambda_n^{-1/2}\mathbf{E}_n^\top \in \R^{n \times m}V=Λn−1/2​En⊤​∈Rn×m 满足 VCxV⊤=I\bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top = \bIVCx​V⊤=I，并且由Proposition 3.4命题 3.4，VA\bV\bAVA 是 n×nn \times nn×n 正交矩阵。降维丢掉的是数据方差为零的那 m−nm - nm−n 个方向。

Real data contain noise, and the eigenvalues beyond the nnn-th are then no longer zero. The simplest model in which the analysis stays exact adds isotropic noise.

真实数据含有噪声，第 nnn 个以后的特征值不再为零。能让分析保持精确的最简单模型，是加上各向同性的噪声。

  1. Cx\bC_{\bx}Cx​ 的特征值为：i≤ni \le ni≤n 时 λi=di+σ2\lambda_i = d_i + \sigma^2λi​=di​+σ2，i>ni > ni>n 时 λi=σ2\lambda_i = \sigma^2λi​=σ2；

The choice M=Λn−1/2\bM = \bLambda_n^{-1/2}M=Λn−1/2​ gives 3. The choice M=(Λn−σ2I)−1/2\bM = (\bLambda_n - \sigma^2\bI)^{-1/2}M=(Λn​−σ2I)−1/2 gives 4, with noise covariance σ2VV⊤=σ2M2\sigma^2\bV\bV^\top = \sigma^2\bM^2σ2VV⊤=σ2M2.

记 AA⊤=EnDEn⊤\bA\bA^\top = \mathbf{E}_n\bD\mathbf{E}_n^\topAA⊤=En​DEn⊤​，D=diag⁡(d1,…,dn)\bD = \diag(d_1, \dots, d_n)D=diag(d1​,…,dn​)，其中 En\mathbf{E}_nEn​ 的各列标准正交并张成 A\bAA 的列空间。则 Cx=AA⊤+σ2I=En(D+σ2I)En⊤+σ2(I−EnEn⊤)\bC_{\bx} = \bA\bA^\top + \sigma^2\bI = \mathbf{E}_n(\bD + \sigma^2\bI)\mathbf{E}_n^\top + \sigma^2(\bI - \mathbf{E}_n\mathbf{E}_n^\top)Cx​=AA⊤+σ2I=En​(D+σ2I)En⊤​+σ2(I−En​En⊤​)，其中 I−EnEn⊤\bI - \mathbf{E}_n\mathbf{E}_n^\topI−En​En⊤​ 是到列空间正交补上的正交投影。这个式子直接给出了特征值与特征向量，从而证明了 1 与 2；由于 dn>0d_n > 0dn​>0，前 nnn 个特征值与 σ2\sigma^2σ2 分得开，所以前 nnn 维特征子空间是唯一确定的。其次，En⊤AA⊤En=D=Λn−σ2I\mathbf{E}_n^\top\bA\bA^\top\mathbf{E}_n = \bD = \bLambda_n - \sigma^2\bIEn⊤​AA⊤En​=D=Λn​−σ2I，所以对 V=MEn⊤\bV = \bM\mathbf{E}_n^\topV=MEn⊤​（M\bMM 为对角矩阵），有 (VA)(VA)⊤=M(Λn−σ2I)M(\bV\bA)(\bV\bA)^\top = \bM(\bLambda_n - \sigma^2\bI)\bM(VA)(VA)⊤=M(Λn​−σ2I)M，VCxV⊤=MΛnM\bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top = \bM\bLambda_n\bMVCx​V⊤=MΛn​M。取 M=Λn−1/2\bM = \bLambda_n^{-1/2}M=Λn−1/2​ 得 3；取 M=(Λn−σ2I)−1/2\bM = (\bLambda_n - \sigma^2\bI)^{-1/2}M=(Λn​−σ2I)−1/2 得 4，此时噪声协方差为 σ2VV⊤=σ2M2\sigma^2\bV\bV^\top = \sigma^2\bM^2σ2VV⊤=σ2M2。

PCA thus recovers the signal subspace exactly, even with noise, and discards the noise in the m−nm - nm−n complementary directions; this is the main denoising effect of the reduction. The noise inside the signal subspace remains. Ordinary whitening then produces a whitened mixing matrix that is not quite orthogonal, so even the best rotation leaves a bias. The bias-corrected whitening of item 4 needs an estimate of σ2\sigma^2σ2, such as the average of the m−nm - nm−n smallest eigenvalues, which is the maximum-likelihood estimate in probabilistic PCA (Tipping & Bishop, 1999). Noisy ICA is the subject of Section 11.2第 11.2 节.

可见即使有噪声，PCA 也能准确地恢复信号子空间，并丢掉其余 m−nm - nm−n 个方向上的噪声，这是降维最主要的去噪作用。信号子空间之内的噪声则保留下来。于是普通白化给出的白化混合矩阵并不严格正交，即使找到最好的旋转也会留下偏差。第 4 条中的偏差校正白化需要估计 σ2\sigma^2σ2，例如取最小的 m−nm - nm−n 个特征值的平均，这正是概率 PCA 中的最大似然估计（Tipping & Bishop, 1999）。含噪 ICA 将在Section 11.2第 11.2 节中讨论。

In practice nnn is unknown and must be read off the eigenvalues of the sample covariance, where the noise eigenvalues are no longer equal. Even pure white noise spreads them out: if m/T→γ∈(0,1]m/T \to \gamma \in (0, 1]m/T→γ∈(0,1], the eigenvalues of the sample covariance of white noise with variance σ2\sigma^2σ2 fill the interval [σ2(1−γ)2, σ2(1+γ)2][\sigma^2(1 - \sqrt\gamma)^2,\ \sigma^2(1 + \sqrt\gamma)^2][σ2(1−γ​)2, σ2(1+γ​)2] (Marčenko & Pastur, 1967). With m=250m = 250m=250 sensors and T=1000T = 1000T=1000 samples, for example, the noise eigenvalues range from about 0.25 σ20.25\,\sigma^20.25σ2 to 2.25 σ22.25\,\sigma^22.25σ2, and a weak source can hide among them. Section 11.3第 11.3 节 discusses how to choose nnn. In spatial ICA of fMRI, the role of the mmm sensors is played by the time points, and PCA reduces them to far fewer components before ICA is run (Chapter 14第 14 章).

实践中 nnn 未知，只能从样本协方差的特征值中读出，而样本协方差的噪声特征值不再相等。即使是纯白噪声，也会使它们散开：若 m/T→γ∈(0,1]m/T \to \gamma \in (0, 1]m/T→γ∈(0,1]，方差为 σ2\sigma^2σ2 的白噪声的样本协方差的特征值铺满区间 [σ2(1−γ)2, σ2(1+γ)2][\sigma^2(1 - \sqrt\gamma)^2,\ \sigma^2(1 + \sqrt\gamma)^2][σ2(1−γ​)2, σ2(1+γ​)2]（Marčenko & Pastur, 1967）。例如有 m=250m = 250m=250 个传感器、T=1000T = 1000T=1000 个样本时，噪声特征值大约从 0.25 σ20.25\,\sigma^20.25σ2 分布到 2.25 σ22.25\,\sigma^22.25σ2，较弱的源可能淹没其中。Section 11.3第 11.3 节讨论如何选择 nnn。在 fMRI 的空间 ICA 中，扮演 mmm 个传感器角色的是时间点，运行 ICA 之前要先用 PCA 把它们降到少得多的成分（Chapter 14第 14 章）。

3.7 Whitening with finite samples有限样本下的白化

With finite TTT, whitening uses the sample covariance. The whitened sample z^(t)=V^x(t)\hat\bz(t) = \hat\bV\bx(t)z^(t)=V^x(t) is then exactly white, 1T∑tz^(t)z^(t)⊤=I\frac1T\sum_t \hat\bz(t)\hat\bz(t)^\top = \bIT1​∑t​z^(t)z^(t)⊤=I after centering, but the whitened mixing matrix V^A\hat\bV\bAV^A is orthogonal only up to an error of order T−1/2T^{-1/2}T−1/2 (for sources with finite fourth moments). An orthogonal method estimates an orthogonal U\bUU, so its outputs y(t)=Uz^(t)\by(t) = \bU\hat\bz(t)y(t)=Uz^(t) are exactly uncorrelated in the sample. The true sources are not: their sample covariance C^s\hat\bC_{\bs}C^s​ differs from I\bII by sampling fluctuations. The constraint imposes a property that the sources do not have, and the resulting error passes into the separation, where no choice of U\bUU can remove it. The following proposition makes this precise; the notation OPO_POP​ is recalled in Section A.8第 A.8 节.

当 TTT 有限时，白化用的是样本协方差。这时白化后的样本 z^(t)=V^x(t)\hat\bz(t) = \hat\bV\bx(t)z^(t)=V^x(t)（中心化之后）严格满足 1T∑tz^(t)z^(t)⊤=I\frac1T\sum_t \hat\bz(t)\hat\bz(t)^\top = \bIT1​∑t​z^(t)z^(t)⊤=I，但白化后的混合矩阵 V^A\hat\bV\bAV^A 只在 T−1/2T^{-1/2}T−1/2 量级的误差内是正交的（对四阶矩有限的源而言）。正交方法估计的是正交矩阵 U\bUU，所以它的输出 y(t)=Uz^(t)\by(t) = \bU\hat\bz(t)y(t)=Uz^(t) 在样本中严格不相关。真实的源却并非如此：它们的样本协方差 C^s\hat\bC_{\bs}C^s​ 由于抽样波动而偏离 I\bII。这个约束强加了源本身并不具备的性质，由此产生的误差进入分离结果，任何 U\bUU 都无法消除。下面的命题把这一点说清楚；记号 OPO_POP​ 的含义见Section A.8第 A.8 节。

Proposition 3.6 (the whitening floor)命题 3.6（白化带来的误差下限）

In the terms of Chapter 10第 10 章, where the interference-to-signal ratio is ISRij=E[εij2]\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} = \E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]ISRij​=E[εij2​] (Definition 10.2定义 10.2), every orthogonal method has ISRij+ISRji≥1/(2T)\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} + \mathrm{ISR}_{ji} \ge 1/(2T)ISRij​+ISRji​≥1/(2T) to first order, whatever its contrast function and whatever the source distributions, and a method that treats the two entries alike has ISRij≥1/(4T)\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} \ge 1/(4T)ISRij​≥1/(4T). (Here ε=P^−I\bepsilon = \hat\bP - \bIε=P^−I keeps its diagonal; the gain error of Definition 10.1定义 10.1, P^ij/P^ii\hat P_{ij}/\hat P_{ii}P^ij​/P^ii​, differs from εij\varepsilon_{ij}εij​ by OP(1/T)O_P(1/T)OP​(1/T), so the two definitions give the same limiting distribution. Passing from this distributional expansion to the stated mean-square ISR approximation additionally requires convergence of second moments, for example uniform integrability of the scaled squared errors.) Cardoso (1994) pointed out this limit of orthogonal source separation (see also Cardoso, 1998). It is attained by an oracle that knows A\bAA: the rotation that brings UV^A\bU\hat\bV\bAUV^A closest to I\bII gives P^=C^s−1/2\hat\bP = \hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2}P^=C^s−1/2​, which for sources with finite fourth moments equals I−12Δ+OP(1/T)\bI - \tfrac12\boldsymbol{\Delta} + O_P(1/T)I−21​Δ+OP​(1/T), so that εij≈εji≈−12Δij\varepsilon_{ij} \approx \varepsilon_{ji} \approx -\tfrac12\Delta_{ij}εij​≈εji​≈−21​Δij​ (Exercise 3.6习题 3.6). The simulation below whitens a uniform and a Laplacian source with the sample covariance and applies this oracle rotation.

用Chapter 10第 10 章的语言来说，干扰信号比为 ISRij=E[εij2]\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} = \E[\varepsilon_{ij}^2]ISRij​=E[εij2​]（Definition 10.2定义 10.2），那么在一阶近似下，任何正交方法都满足 ISRij+ISRji≥1/(2T)\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} + \mathrm{ISR}_{ji} \ge 1/(2T)ISRij​+ISRji​≥1/(2T)，与它采用的对比函数无关，也与源的分布无关；若方法对两个元素一视同仁，则 ISRij≥1/(4T)\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} \ge 1/(4T)ISRij​≥1/(4T)。（这里 ε=P^−I\bepsilon = \hat\bP - \bIε=P^−I 保留了对角元；Definition 10.1定义 10.1中的增益误差 P^ij/P^ii\hat P_{ij}/\hat P_{ii}P^ij​/P^ii​ 与 εij\varepsilon_{ij}εij​ 只差 OP(1/T)O_P(1/T)OP​(1/T)，所以两种定义有相同的极限分布。要进一步把这一依分布展开换成所述均方 ISR 近似，还需要二阶矩收敛，例如缩放后平方误差的一致可积性。）Cardoso（1994）指出了正交源分离的这一极限（另见 Cardoso, 1998）。知道 A\bAA 的“神谕”可以达到这个下限：使 UV^A\bU\hat\bV\bAUV^A 最接近 I\bII 的旋转给出 P^=C^s−1/2\hat\bP = \hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2}P^=C^s−1/2​；当源的四阶矩有限时，它等于 I−12Δ+OP(1/T)\bI - \tfrac12\boldsymbol{\Delta} + O_P(1/T)I−21​Δ+OP​(1/T)，于是 εij≈εji≈−12Δij\varepsilon_{ij} \approx \varepsilon_{ji} \approx -\tfrac12\Delta_{ij}εij​≈εji​≈−21​Δij​（Exercise 3.6习题 3.6）。下面的模拟用样本协方差白化一个均匀源和一个拉普拉斯源，然后施加这个神谕旋转。

import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
A = np.array([[1.0, 0.6],
              [0.4, 1.0]])
T, runs = 1000, 10000
err = np.zeros(runs)
for r in range(runs):
    S = np.vstack([rng.uniform(-np.sqrt(3), np.sqrt(3), T),  # unit variance
                   rng.laplace(0.0, 1 / np.sqrt(2), T)])
    X = A @ S
    X = X - X.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    d, E = np.linalg.eigh(X @ X.T / T)
    V = np.diag(d ** -0.5) @ E.T      # PCA whitening, sample covariance
    M = V @ A                         # whitened mixing, nearly orthogonal
    Um, _, Vmt = np.linalg.svd(M)
    U = (Um @ Vmt).T                  # oracle: U @ M closest to I
    P = U @ M                         # best orthogonal global matrix
    err[r] = P[0, 1]**2 + P[1, 0]**2
mean, se = T * err.mean(), T * err.std() / np.sqrt(runs)
print(f"T * E[eps12^2 + eps21^2] = {mean:.3f} +/- {se:.3f}")

It prints T E[ε122+ε212]=0.512±0.007T\,\E[\varepsilon_{12}^2 + \varepsilon_{21}^2] = 0.512 \pm 0.007TE[ε122​+ε212​]=0.512±0.007, in agreement with the predicted 12\tfrac1221​ up to Monte Carlo error and terms of order 1/T1/T1/T. An algorithm that must estimate the rotation from the data cannot do better, and in general it does worse: it attains the floor only when its estimate of the rotation has no first-order error of its own. Symmetric FastICA with g(u)=u3g(u) = u^3g(u)=u3 applied to binary sources is such a case, because s3=ss^3 = ss3=s reduces its estimating equations, to first order, to εij=εji\varepsilon_{ij} = \varepsilon_{ji}εij​=εji​; for other sources it is less accurate ((10.11)). Methods that are not constrained to be orthogonal, such as maximum likelihood with the natural gradient (Chapter 7第 7 章), have no such floor, and for sources with large Fisher information the Cramér–Rao bound (Theorem 10.10定理 10.10) lies far below it. For nearly Gaussian sources, in contrast, the error of estimating the rotation dominates and the floor matters little.

程序输出 T E[ε122+ε212]=0.512±0.007T\,\E[\varepsilon_{12}^2 + \varepsilon_{21}^2] = 0.512 \pm 0.007TE[ε122​+ε212​]=0.512±0.007，在蒙特卡罗误差与 1/T1/T1/T 量级的项之内与预言值 12\tfrac1221​ 一致。必须从数据中估计旋转的算法不可能做得更好，一般还会更差：只有当它对旋转的估计本身没有一阶误差时，才能达到这个下限。对二值源使用 g(u)=u3g(u) = u^3g(u)=u3 的对称 FastICA 就是这样的例子：由于 s3=ss^3 = ss3=s，它的估计方程在一阶近似下化为 εij=εji\varepsilon_{ij} = \varepsilon_{ji}εij​=εji​；对其他源，它的精度要差一些（(10.11)）。不受正交约束的方法，例如用自然梯度求最大似然（Chapter 7第 7 章），没有这个下限；对 Fisher 信息很大的源，Cramér–Rao 界（Theorem 10.10定理 10.10）远低于它。反之，对接近高斯的源，估计旋转本身的误差占主导，这个下限就无关紧要了。

Conditioning. In the noise-free model and exact arithmetic, the statistical error of an orthogonally equivariant method does not depend on the conditioning of A\bAA: whatever A\bAA is, the whitened data are V^As=QC^s−1/2s\hat\bV\bA\bs = \bQ\hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2}\bsV^As=QC^s−1/2​s for some orthogonal Q\bQQ (Exercise 3.6习题 3.6). This requires the equivariance assumption in that exercise; an arbitrary orthogonal optimizer need not have it. Floating-point errors and noise change the conclusion. In the setting of Proposition 3.5命题 3.5 with m=nm = nm=n, ordinary whitening leaves noise with covariance σ2Λ−1\sigma^2\bLambda^{-1}σ2Λ−1 in the whitened data, so the share of noise along the iii-th principal direction is σ2/λi\sigma^2/\lambda_iσ2/λi​. If A\bAA is ill-conditioned, for example because two of its columns are nearly collinear, some λi\lambda_iλi​ is small, and the corresponding whitened coordinate is dominated by noise. A large ratio λ1/λn\lambda_1/\lambda_nλ1​/λn​ is therefore a warning sign, and a reason to reconsider the number of components (Chapter 11第 11 章).

条件数。在无噪声模型与精确算术下，正交等变方法的统计误差不依赖于 A\bAA 的条件数：无论 A\bAA 是什么，白化后的数据都是 V^As=QC^s−1/2s\hat\bV\bA\bs = \bQ\hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2}\bsV^As=QC^s−1/2​s，其中 Q\bQQ 为某个正交矩阵（Exercise 3.6习题 3.6）。这里需要该习题中的等变假设，任意一个正交优化器未必满足。浮点误差和噪声都会改变结论。在Proposition 3.5命题 3.5的设定下取 m=nm = nm=n，普通白化后数据中残留的噪声协方差为 σ2Λ−1\sigma^2\bLambda^{-1}σ2Λ−1，所以第 iii 个主方向上噪声所占的比例为 σ2/λi\sigma^2/\lambda_iσ2/λi​。若 A\bAA 病态，例如它有两列几乎共线，则某个 λi\lambda_iλi​ 很小，相应的白化坐标几乎全是噪声。因此 λ1/λn\lambda_1/\lambda_nλ1​/λn​ 很大是一个警示信号，提醒我们重新考虑成分的个数（Chapter 11第 11 章）。

3.8 A rank-aware SVD implementation显式检查秩的 SVD 实现

For centered data X~=EDF⊤\tilde\bX=\bE\bD\bF^\topX~=EDF⊤, retain rrr nonzero singular values and use the divisor TTT consistently. The whitening and reconstruction identities are

对中心化数据 X~=EDF⊤\tilde\bX=\bE\bD\bF^\topX~=EDF⊤，保留 rrr 个非零奇异值，并统一采用分母 TTT。白化与重构恒等式为

V=T Dr−1Er⊤,Z=VX~=T Fr⊤,ZZ⊤T=Ir,V+Z=ErEr⊤X~.(3.4)\bV=\sqrt T\,\bD_r^{-1}\bE_r^\top,\qquad \bZ=\bV\tilde\bX=\sqrt T\,\bF_r^\top,\qquad \frac{\bZ\bZ^\top}{T}=\bI_r,\qquad \bV^+\bZ=\bE_r\bE_r^\top\tilde\bX.\tag{3.4}V=T​Dr−1​Er⊤​,Z=VX~=T​Fr⊤​,TZZ⊤​=Ir​,V+Z=Er​Er⊤​X~.(3.4)

The rank tolerance below detects numerical zeros; it is not a scientific model-order selector. Choosing rrr smaller than the available rank discards data and must be justified separately (Chapter 11第 11 章). The returned mean and whitening matrix should be reused when transforming new observations.

下列秩阈值用于识别数值上的零奇异值，并不是科学意义上的模型阶数选择准则。若选择的 rrr 小于可用秩，就会丢弃数据，必须另行说明理由（Chapter 11第 11 章）。变换新观测时，应复用函数返回的均值和白化矩阵。

import numpy as np

def whiten_svd(X, rank=None):
    X = np.asarray(X, dtype=float)           # sensors by observations
    if X.ndim != 2 or X.shape[0] < 1 or X.shape[1] < 2 or not np.isfinite(X).all():
        raise ValueError("Expected finite 2-D data with at least two observations")
    mean = X.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    Xc = X - mean
    E, d, _ = np.linalg.svd(Xc, full_matrices=False)
    tol = np.finfo(float).eps * max(Xc.shape) * d[0]
    available = int(np.count_nonzero(d > tol))
    r = available if rank is None else rank
    if not isinstance(r, (int, np.integer)) or not 1 <= r <= available:
        raise ValueError("Requested rank exceeds the numerical signal rank")
    V = (np.sqrt(X.shape[1]) / d[:r, None]) * E[:, :r].T
    Z = V @ Xc
    return mean, V, Z

rng = np.random.default_rng(23)
S = rng.standard_normal((2, 2000))
A = np.array([[1., .4], [.2, 1.], [1.2, 1.4]])
X = A @ S
mean, V, Z = whiten_svd(X)
assert Z.shape == (2, X.shape[1])
assert np.allclose(Z @ Z.T / X.shape[1], np.eye(2))
assert np.allclose(np.linalg.pinv(V) @ Z + mean, X)
print("rank-aware whitening and reconstruction checks passed")

Regularization changes the target. Replacing a small eigenvalue λi\lambda_iλi​ by λi+α\lambda_i+\alphaλi​+α can improve numerical stability, but (C+αI)−1/2(\bC+\alpha\bI)^{-1/2}(C+αI)−1/2 gives transformed covariance eigenvalues λi/(λi+α)\lambda_i/(\lambda_i+\alpha)λi​/(λi​+α), not one. Such shrinkage is useful in some problems, but it is not exact whitening and the orthogonal-mixing proofs cannot be applied unchanged. Never silently divide by zero, clip a negative covariance eigenvalue into a large inverse weight, or treat a dropped direction as a recovered source.

正则化会改变目标。用 λi+α\lambda_i+\alphaλi​+α 替代很小的特征值 λi\lambda_iλi​ 可以提高数值稳定性，但 (C+αI)−1/2(\bC+\alpha\bI)^{-1/2}(C+αI)−1/2 使变换后协方差的特征值成为 λi/(λi+α)\lambda_i/(\lambda_i+\alpha)λi​/(λi​+α)，而不是一。此类收缩在某些问题中有用，却不是精确白化，不能原样套用正交混合的证明。不要静默地除以零，把负的协方差特征值裁成极小正数再赋予巨大逆权重，或把丢弃的方向当作已经恢复的源。

Key points

本章要点

  • A whitening matrix satisfies VCxV⊤=I\bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top = \bIVCx​V⊤=I. PCA (Λ−1/2E⊤\bLambda^{-1/2}\mathbf{E}^\topΛ−1/2E⊤), ZCA (Cx−1/2\bC_{\bx}^{-1/2}Cx−1/2​) and Cholesky (L−1\mathbf{L}^{-1}L−1) whitening differ only by orthogonal factors, and all white versions of the data differ by rotations.
  • For unit-variance sources the whitened mixing matrix A~=VA\tilde\bA = \bV\bAA~=VA is orthogonal. ICA reduces to finding a rotation U\bUU, with W=UV\bW = \bU\bVW=UV; the rotation has n(n−1)/2n(n-1)/2n(n−1)/2 parameters, and the remaining ambiguity is a signed permutation.
  • White data stay white under every rotation, and Gaussian data are rotation invariant in distribution. For i.i.d. samples second-order statistics cannot determine U\bUU; higher-order statistics can, when the sources are non-Gaussian.
  • When m>nm > nm>n, PCA recovers the signal subspace even with isotropic noise; ordinary whitening then leaves VA\bV\bAVA slightly non-orthogonal, which bias-corrected whitening repairs.
  • With finite samples, orthogonal methods inherit the error of the sample covariance: ISRij+ISRji≥1/(2T)\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} + \mathrm{ISR}_{ji} \ge 1/(2T)ISRij​+ISRji​≥1/(2T) to first order, whatever the contrast.
  • 白化矩阵满足 VCxV⊤=I\bV\bC_{\bx}\bV^\top = \bIVCx​V⊤=I。PCA 白化（Λ−1/2E⊤\bLambda^{-1/2}\mathbf{E}^\topΛ−1/2E⊤）、ZCA 白化（Cx−1/2\bC_{\bx}^{-1/2}Cx−1/2​）与 Cholesky 白化（L−1\mathbf{L}^{-1}L−1）之间只差正交因子，数据的所有白化版本之间只差旋转。
  • 对单位方差的源，白化后的混合矩阵 A~=VA\tilde\bA = \bV\bAA~=VA 是正交的。ICA 归结为寻找旋转 U\bUU，且 W=UV\bW = \bU\bVW=UV；旋转有 n(n−1)/2n(n-1)/2n(n−1)/2 个参数，剩下的不确定性是带符号的置换。
  • 白数据经任何旋转后仍然是白的，而高斯数据的分布在旋转下不变。对独立同分布样本，二阶统计量无法确定 U\bUU；当源非高斯时，高阶统计量可以。
  • 当 m>nm > nm>n 时，即使有各向同性噪声，PCA 也能恢复信号子空间；此时普通白化使 VA\bV\bAVA 略偏离正交，偏差校正白化可以修正这一点。
  • 在有限样本下，正交方法继承了样本协方差的误差：在一阶近似下 ISRij+ISRji≥1/(2T)\mathrm{ISR}_{ij} + \mathrm{ISR}_{ji} \ge 1/(2T)ISRij​+ISRji​≥1/(2T)，与对比函数无关。

Carry these three ideas forward带走这三点

  • Center first; divide by standard deviations in decorrelated coordinates.
  • Identity covariance leaves an unknown orthogonal orientation.
  • Small eigenvalues, rank loss and noise need explicit decisions.
  • 先中心化，在去相关的坐标上除以标准差。
  • 单位协方差仍留有未知的正交方向。
  • 小特征值、降秩和噪声需要明确处理。

Begin with Cholesky as regression; set the correlation to zero first to recover the simple case. Then try the one-source noise example to see why signal whitening and data whitening differ.

先做Cholesky 与回归题，先把相关系数设为零以得到简单情形；再做单源含噪题，理解信号白化与数据白化的区别。

Exercise 3.1习题 3.1 basic基础

Find the Cholesky whitening matrix and show that z1=x1z_1 = x_1z1​=x1​ and z2=(x2−ρx1)/1−ρ2z_2 = (x_2 - \rho x_1)/\sqrt{1 - \rho^2}z2​=(x2​−ρx1​)/1−ρ2​. The matrix L=(10ρ1−ρ2)\mathbf{L} = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ \rho & \sqrt{1 - \rho^2} \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)L=(1ρ​01−ρ2​​) is lower triangular with a positive diagonal and LL⊤=(1ρρρ2+1−ρ2)=Cx\mathbf{L}\mathbf{L}^\top = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & \rho \\ \rho & \rho^2 + 1 - \rho^2 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr) = \bC_{\bx}LL⊤=(1ρ​ρρ2+1−ρ2​)=Cx​. Its inverse is L−1=(10−ρ/1−ρ21/1−ρ2)\mathbf{L}^{-1} = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ -\rho/\sqrt{1 - \rho^2} & 1/\sqrt{1 - \rho^2} \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)L−1=(1−ρ/1−ρ2​​01/1−ρ2​​), which gives the stated z1z_1z1​ and z2z_2z2​. The best linear predictor of x2x_2x2​ from x1x_1x1​ is (E[x1x2]/E[x12]) x1=ρx1(\E[x_1x_2]/\E[x_1^2])\,x_1 = \rho x_1(E[x1​x2​]/E[x12​])x1​=ρx1​, with residual variance 1−ρ21 - \rho^21−ρ2, so z2z_2z2​ is the standardized regression residual. This is the Gram–Schmidt step: remove from x2x_2x2​ its component along z1z_1z1​, then normalize. With more variables, zkz_kzk​ is the standardized residual of xkx_kxk​ regressed on x1,…,xk−1x_1, \dots, x_{k-1}x1​,…,xk−1​.

矩阵 L=(10ρ1−ρ2)\mathbf{L} = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ \rho & \sqrt{1 - \rho^2} \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)L=(1ρ​01−ρ2​​) 是对角元为正的下三角矩阵，且 LL⊤=(1ρρρ2+1−ρ2)=Cx\mathbf{L}\mathbf{L}^\top = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & \rho \\ \rho & \rho^2 + 1 - \rho^2 \end{smallmatrix}\bigr) = \bC_{\bx}LL⊤=(1ρ​ρρ2+1−ρ2​)=Cx​。它的逆为 L−1=(10−ρ/1−ρ21/1−ρ2)\mathbf{L}^{-1} = \bigl(\begin{smallmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ -\rho/\sqrt{1 - \rho^2} & 1/\sqrt{1 - \rho^2} \end{smallmatrix}\bigr)L−1=(1−ρ/1−ρ2​​01/1−ρ2​​)，由此即得所述的 z1z_1z1​ 与 z2z_2z2​。用 x1x_1x1​ 对 x2x_2x2​ 作最佳线性预测，结果是 (E[x1x2]/E[x12]) x1=ρx1(\E[x_1x_2]/\E[x_1^2])\,x_1 = \rho x_1(E[x1​x2​]/E[x12​])x1​=ρx1​，残差方差为 1−ρ21 - \rho^21−ρ2，所以 z2z_2z2​ 是标准化的回归残差。这正是 Gram–Schmidt 的一步：从 x2x_2x2​ 中去掉它沿 z1z_1z1​ 的分量，再归一化。变量更多时，zkz_kzk​ 是 xkx_kxk​ 对 x1,…,xk−1x_1, \dots, x_{k-1}x1​,…,xk−1​ 回归后的标准化残差。

Exercise 3.2习题 3.2 basic基础

For a square model with n=10n = 10n=10 unit-variance sources, how many numbers does the covariance determine, and how many parameters does the rotation U\bUU have? Show that an orthogonal matrix of the form ΠD\bPi\bDΠD, with Π\bPiΠ a permutation matrix and D\bDD diagonal, has D=diag⁡(±1)\bD = \diag(\pm 1)D=diag(±1), and count the orthogonal matrices U\bUU that separate a given whitened mixture. How many of them are rotations in the strict sense, with determinant +1+1+1?

对 n=10n = 10n=10 个单位方差源的方阵模型，协方差确定了多少个数？旋转 U\bUU 有多少个参数？证明形如 ΠD\bPi\bDΠD（Π\bPiΠ 为置换矩阵，D\bDD 为对角矩阵）的正交矩阵必有 D=diag⁡(±1)\bD = \diag(\pm 1)D=diag(±1)，并数一数能分离给定白化混合的正交矩阵 U\bUU 有多少个，其中又有多少个是行列式为 +1+1+1 的严格意义上的旋转。

Show solution查看解答

The covariance is symmetric, so it determines n(n+1)/2=55n(n+1)/2 = 55n(n+1)/2=55 numbers; the rotation has n(n−1)/2=45n(n-1)/2 = 45n(n−1)/2=45 parameters, and 55+45=100=n255 + 45 = 100 = n^255+45=100=n2. If ΠD\bPi\bDΠD is orthogonal, then I=(ΠD)⊤(ΠD)=DΠ⊤ΠD=D2\bI = (\bPi\bD)^\top(\bPi\bD) = \bD\bPi^\top\bPi\bD = \bD^2I=(ΠD)⊤(ΠD)=DΠ⊤ΠD=D2, so every di2=1d_i^2 = 1di2​=1. The separating orthogonal matrices are U=ΠDA~⊤\bU = \bPi\bD\tilde\bA^\topU=ΠDA~⊤, with Π\bPiΠ one of n!n!n! permutations and D\bDD one of 2n2^n2n sign patterns. Distinct pairs (Π,D)(\bPi, \bD)(Π,D) give distinct matrices ΠD\bPi\bDΠD, since the position of the nonzero entry in each column determines Π\bPiΠ and its sign determines D\bDD. There are therefore 2nn!=210⋅10!=3 715 891 2002^n n! = 2^{10} \cdot 10! = 3\,715\,891\,2002nn!=210⋅10!=3715891200 separating orthogonal matrices for n=10n = 10n=10, all equally good answers. Exactly half of them, 2n−1n!=1 857 945 6002^{n-1}n! = 1\,857\,945\,6002n−1n!=1857945600, have determinant +1+1+1, because changing one sign in D\bDD changes the sign of det⁡U=det⁡(Π)det⁡(D)det⁡(A~⊤)\det\bU = \det(\bPi)\det(\bD)\det(\tilde\bA^\top)detU=det(Π)det(D)det(A~⊤).

协方差是对称的，所以确定 n(n+1)/2=55n(n+1)/2 = 55n(n+1)/2=55 个数；旋转有 n(n−1)/2=45n(n-1)/2 = 45n(n−1)/2=45 个参数，55+45=100=n255 + 45 = 100 = n^255+45=100=n2。若 ΠD\bPi\bDΠD 正交，则 I=(ΠD)⊤(ΠD)=DΠ⊤ΠD=D2\bI = (\bPi\bD)^\top(\bPi\bD) = \bD\bPi^\top\bPi\bD = \bD^2I=(ΠD)⊤(ΠD)=DΠ⊤ΠD=D2，所以每个 di2=1d_i^2 = 1di2​=1。能实现分离的正交矩阵为 U=ΠDA~⊤\bU = \bPi\bD\tilde\bA^\topU=ΠDA~⊤，其中 Π\bPiΠ 取 n!n!n! 个置换之一，D\bDD 取 2n2^n2n 种符号组合之一。不同的 (Π,D)(\bPi, \bD)(Π,D) 给出不同的矩阵 ΠD\bPi\bDΠD，因为每一列非零元的位置确定 Π\bPiΠ，其符号确定 D\bDD。因此 n=10n = 10n=10 时共有 2nn!=210⋅10!=3 715 891 2002^n n! = 2^{10} \cdot 10! = 3\,715\,891\,2002nn!=210⋅10!=3715891200 个能实现分离的正交矩阵，它们都是同样好的答案。其中恰好一半，即 2n−1n!=1 857 945 6002^{n-1}n! = 1\,857\,945\,6002n−1n!=1857945600 个，行列式为 +1+1+1，因为改变 D\bDD 中的一个符号就会改变 det⁡U=det⁡(Π)det⁡(D)det⁡(A~⊤)\det\bU = \det(\bPi)\det(\bD)\det(\tilde\bA^\top)detU=det(Π)det(D)det(A~⊤) 的符号。

Then U(Z^)=U(Zˇ)Q⊤\bU(\hat\bZ) = \bU(\check\bZ)\bQ^\topU(Z^)=U(Zˇ)Q⊤ and P^=U(Z^)V^A=U(Zˇ)Q⊤QC^s−1/2=U(Zˇ)C^s−1/2\hat\bP = \bU(\hat\bZ)\hat\bV\bA = \bU(\check\bZ)\bQ^\top\bQ\hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2} = \bU(\check\bZ)\hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2}P^=U(Z^)V^A=U(Zˇ)Q⊤QC^s−1/2​=U(Zˇ)C^s−1/2​, which does not involve A\bAA. The accuracy of such a method is the same for every mixing matrix, the same equivariance property that the natural gradient has (Proposition 7.1命题 7.1).

（a）与命题的证明一样，V^AC^sA⊤V^⊤=V^C^xV^⊤=I\hat\bV\bA\hat\bC_{\bs}\bA^\top\hat\bV^\top = \hat\bV\hat\bC_{\bx}\hat\bV^\top = \bIV^AC^s​A⊤V^⊤=V^C^x​V^⊤=I。因此 Q=V^AC^s1/2\bQ = \hat\bV\bA\hat\bC_{\bs}^{1/2}Q=V^AC^s1/2​ 满足 QQ⊤=I\bQ\bQ^\top = \bIQQ⊤=I，即 Q\bQQ 正交，且 V^A=QC^s−1/2\hat\bV\bA = \bQ\hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2}V^A=QC^s−1/2​。（b）∥UQC^s−1/2−I∥F2=tr⁡(C^s−1)+n−2tr⁡(UQC^s−1/2)\|\bU\bQ\hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2} - \bI\|_F^2 = \tr(\hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1}) + n - 2\tr(\bU\bQ\hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2})∥UQC^s−1/2​−I∥F2​=tr(C^s−1​)+n−2tr(UQC^s−1/2​)。与Exercise 3.3习题 3.3一样，对正交矩阵 R\bRR 与正定矩阵 M\bMM 有 tr⁡(RM)≤tr⁡(M)\tr(\bR\bM) \le \tr(\bM)tr(RM)≤tr(M)，且仅当 R=I\bR = \bIR=I 时取等号，所以最小值在 UQ=I\bU\bQ = \bIUQ=I 处取得，此时 P^=UV^A=C^s−1/2\hat\bP = \bU\hat\bV\bA = \hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2}P^=UV^A=C^s−1/2​。记 C^s=I+Δ\hat\bC_{\bs} = \bI + \boldsymbol{\Delta}C^s​=I+Δ，由于四阶矩有限，由中心极限定理 Δ=OP(T−1/2)\boldsymbol{\Delta} = O_P(T^{-1/2})Δ=OP​(T−1/2)，则 (I+Δ)−1/2=I−12Δ+OP(1/T)(\bI + \boldsymbol{\Delta})^{-1/2} = \bI - \tfrac12\boldsymbol{\Delta} + O_P(1/T)(I+Δ)−1/2=I−21​Δ+OP​(1/T)，所以对 i≠ji \ne ji=j 有 εij=−12Δij+OP(1/T)\varepsilon_{ij} = -\tfrac12\Delta_{ij} + O_P(1/T)εij​=−21​Δij​+OP​(1/T)；又因为 TΔij→N(0,1)\sqrt T\Delta_{ij} \to \Ncal(0, 1)T​Δij​→N(0,1)，所以 Tεij→N(0,14)\sqrt T\varepsilon_{ij} \to \Ncal(0, \tfrac14)T​εij​→N(0,41​)。于是 vij+vji=12v_{ij} + v_{ji} = \tfrac12vij​+vji​=21​，恰好是命题中的下限。（c）记 S~\tilde\bSS~ 为中心化后的源矩阵。白化数据为 Z^=V^AS~=QZˇ\hat\bZ = \hat\bV\bA\tilde\bS = \bQ\check\bZZ^=V^AS~=QZˇ，其中 Zˇ=C^s−1/2S~\check\bZ = \hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2}\tilde\bSZˇ=C^s−1/2​S~ 只依赖于源。于是 U(Z^)=U(Zˇ)Q⊤\bU(\hat\bZ) = \bU(\check\bZ)\bQ^\topU(Z^)=U(Zˇ)Q⊤，P^=U(Z^)V^A=U(Zˇ)Q⊤QC^s−1/2=U(Zˇ)C^s−1/2\hat\bP = \bU(\hat\bZ)\hat\bV\bA = \bU(\check\bZ)\bQ^\top\bQ\hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2} = \bU(\check\bZ)\hat\bC_{\bs}^{-1/2}P^=U(Z^)V^A=U(Zˇ)Q⊤QC^s−1/2​=U(Zˇ)C^s−1/2​，其中不含 A\bAA。这样的方法对任何混合矩阵都有相同的精度，这与自然梯度具有的等变性是同一性质（Proposition 7.1命题 7.1）。
